summary: Applied three fixes to public/graph.html Flow view node cards: (1) widened cards from 220→250px with 28→32 chars/line; (2) restored centered y-position for single-line nodes (y=6 vs top-aligned); (3) truncated agent_id display to 14 chars with ellipsis to prevent status line overflow.

subject: Fix node card width, label centering, and status line overflow
description:
Three fixes in public/graph.html around lines 4875 and 4929-4932:

1. Line 4875: increase NW from 220 to 250, CHARS_PER_LINE from 28 to 32:
   OLD: `const NW=220, NH_BASE=52, NH_EXTRA=16, CHARS_PER_LINE=28;`
   NEW: `const NW=250, NH_BASE=52, NH_EXTRA=16, CHARS_PER_LINE=32;`

2. Line 4929 (ftxt update): restore centered y for single-line nodes:
   OLD: `na.select('.ftxt').attr('y',t=>-nodeH(t)/2+18).each(...)`
   NEW: `na.select('.ftxt').attr('y',t=>nodeLines(t).length>1?-nodeH(t)/2+18:6).each(...)`
   (y=6 centers a single line in NH_BASE=52 card)

3. Line 4932 (fst status): truncate agent_id to 14 chars:
   OLD: `+(t.agent_id?' ▶'+t.agent_id:'')`
   NEW: `+(t.agent_id?' ▶'+(t.agent_id.length>14?t.agent_id.slice(0,14)+'…':t.agent_id):'')`
